events.title: Demo 0.5.0 — Trilith, Kestrel, the Praetor, Gale, Outpost
events.summary: New mini-bossesTrilith. Three stones form a triangle around you. When it lights up, get out before it fires, or break a stone to stop it.Kestrel. A big bird that circles you, then dives at you along a curved line.Both show up from planet 3 and in Endless. The camera zooms out while a mini-boss is alive. New boss in the demo: the PraetorA wall of shielded enemies that marches down the screen. Break through it and kill the commander inside. It can show up on any planet. New hazards and perksGale.

events.title: Demo 0.4.0 — Eye of the Storm, heal pods, the Clinker, 40 routes
events.summary: Eye of the StormA new hazard. Every so often a storm sweeps the whole field, and everything outside one drifting green circle takes damage until it passes. You get a warning first, and an arrow points to the circle when it's off screen. It's the first hazard that tells you where to go instead of where not to stand. events.title: Demo 0.3.0 — mini-bosses, three new bosses, sixteen new items, a radio
events.summary: Mini-bossesPlanet 3 stages now spawn mini-bosses. A mini-boss is a large elite with its own health bar that arrives during a stage. When it arrives, most of the enemies on screen are cleared out. Killing it pays a gold bounty. A stage can get one, two, or none. There are twelve, and a stage never spawns the same one twice. events.title: Demo 0.2.0 — five new enemies, meaner bosses, smarter gold
events.summary: The bestiary just grewFive new hostiles now roam the three demo planets. The Cursive carves flowing patterns straight through your dodge lane. The Tessera teleports along an invisible grid, so it's never where you last saw it. The Radian hops in sweeping compass arcs. The Saltire drifts in lazily, then bursts bullets in a big X. And on planet 3, look up: the Perseid is a meteor you cannot shoot, streaking across the screen aimed at where you're about to be. Keep moving. Dead shooters shoot backE
